# Sortable List

> A list the user puts in order, by dragging each item by its handle or with the keyboard, while a screenreader hears where the item is as it moves.

`<slab-sortable-list>` · Data · built on `[role=list] + handle <button>s`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/sortable-list/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/sortable-list.js';
import 'slab-elements/sortable-list.item.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-sortable-list label="Priorities">
  <slab-sortable-list-item label="Footings">
    <svg slot="handle" aria-hidden="true">…</svg>
    Footings
  </slab-sortable-list-item>
  <slab-sortable-list-item label="Walls">
    <svg slot="handle" aria-hidden="true">…</svg>
    Walls
  </slab-sortable-list-item>
</slab-sortable-list>
```

Each item has a handle, a `<button>` named "Reorder" and the item's `label`. Drag it, and the item moves as the pointer passes the middle of the items around it. Or press Space or Enter on it to pick the item up, move it with the arrow keys, and press Space or Enter again to drop it. Escape, or moving focus away, puts it back where it was. What's in the handle is yours, such as a grip icon in its `handle` slot.

Screenreaders hear where the item is at each step, such as "Walls picked up at position 2 of 3" and "Walls moved to position 1 of 3", and each handle is described with how to move it. Word them yourself with `instructions-label` and the `grabbedLabel`, `movedLabel`, `droppedLabel` and `canceledLabel` functions, which take the item's label, its position from 1 and the number of items.

Sortable List moves the items in the DOM itself, so their order there is always the list's, and dispatches "change" when an item is dropped somewhere new. Read the new order from `items`. In a framework that renders the items from an array, set the array from `items` on "change" and key each item, so the framework's order and the list's agree. An item has `:state(grabbed)` while it's picked up or dragged.

For motion, give the items a `view-transition-name`, such as `view-transition-name: match-element`, and each move happens in a view transition, so the items glide to their new places, as in the example above. Style the animation with `::view-transition-group()` in your page's CSS. The items move at once when they have no name, in a browser without view transitions, or for someone who prefers reduced motion.

## Keyboard

| Key                  | What it does                                                    |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tab                  | Moves to each item's handle, then to what's in the item.        |
| Space, Enter         | On a handle, picks its item up. While it's picked up, drops it. |
| Up Arrow, Down Arrow | Moves a picked up item one place earlier or later.              |
| Home, End            | Moves a picked up item to the start or the end of the list.     |
| Escape               | Puts a picked up or dragged item back where it was.             |

## Elements

### `<slab-sortable-list>`

Import `slab-elements/sortable-list.js` to register it.

A Sortable List with no visual styles: a list whose items the user puts in order, by dragging them or with the keyboard, such as a playlist or a list of priorities.

Each Sortable List Item has a handle, a `<button>`. Drag it and the item moves as the pointer passes the items around it. Or press Space or Enter on it to pick the item up, the arrow keys to move it, Home and End to move it to the start or end, Space or Enter to drop it, and Escape to put it back where it was. Moving focus away while it's picked up puts it back as well.

Screenreaders are told where the item is as it's picked up, moved, dropped or put back, such as "Pour moved to position 2 of 3". Change what they're told with `grabbedLabel`, `movedLabel`, `droppedLabel` and `canceledLabel`.

Sortable List moves the items themselves, so their order in the DOM is always the list's. It dispatches "change" when an item is dropped somewhere new, and `items` is the new order.

#### Attributes

| Name                 | Type     | Default | Description                                                                                 |
| -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required)   | `string` |         | Names the list.                                                                             |
| `instructions-label` | `string` |         | Describes each handle to screenreaders. "Press Space to pick it up…" in English when unset. |

#### Properties

| Name                | Type                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `canceledLabel`     | `Announcement`       | What screenreaders are told when an item is put back, from its label and where it is, from 1. "Reorder canceled…" in English when unset.                                              |
| `droppedLabel`      | `Announcement`       | What screenreaders are told when an item is dropped, from its label and where it is, from 1. "Pour dropped at position 2 of 3" and so on in English when unset.                       |
| `grabbedLabel`      | `Announcement`       | What screenreaders are told when an item is picked up with the keyboard, from its label and where it is, from 1. "Pour picked up at position 2 of 3" and so on in English when unset. |
| `movedLabel`        | `Announcement`       | What screenreaders are told when a picked up item is moved, from its label and where it is, from 1. "Pour moved to position 2 of 3" and so on in English when unset.                  |
| `items` (read-only) | `SortableListItem[]` | Its items, in order.                                                                                                                                                                  |

#### Events

| Name     | Type    | Description                                             |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change` | `Event` | When the user moves an item somewhere else in the list. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type               | Description         |
| --------- | ------------------ | ------------------- |
| (default) | `SortableListItem` | The items, in order |

#### CSS parts

| Name   | Description |
| ------ | ----------- |
| `list` | The items   |

### `<slab-sortable-list-item>`

Import `slab-elements/sortable-list.item.js` to register it.

A Sortable List Item with no visual styles: one item of its Sortable List, with a handle that moves it.

The handle is a `<button>` named "Reorder" and the item's `label`, and it's described by its Sortable List's `instructions-label`. Drag it to move the item, or press Space or Enter on it to pick the item up, the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, and Escape to put it back.

What goes in the handle is yours, such as a grip icon, through its `handle` slot. The handle is `aria-pressed` while the item is picked up.

Style it through its parts and `:state(grabbed)`, which it has while it's picked up or dragged.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type     | Default | Description                                                                          |
| ------------------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `label` (required) | `string` |         | Names the item, in its handle's name and in what screenreaders are told as it moves. |
| `handle-label`     | `string` |         | Names the handle. "Reorder" and `label` in English when unset.                       |

#### Properties

| Name           | Type      | Description               |
| -------------- | --------- | ------------------------- |
| `grabbed`      | `boolean` | Set by its Sortable List. |
| `instructions` | `string`  | Set by its Sortable List. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description                              |
| --------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `handle`  | `Element \| string` | Shown in the handle, such as a grip icon |
| (default) | `Element \| string` | The item's content                       |

#### CSS parts

| Name      | Description                    |
| --------- | ------------------------------ |
| `content` | Holds the content              |
| `handle`  | The button that moves the item |

#### CSS states

| Name              | Description                      |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `:state(grabbed)` | While it's picked up or dragged. |
